standard.title: Artifact Publication Hygiene
standard.summary: Published OSERA releases preserve the ecosystem's expected package files and bind each promoted file to the patched release with retained acceptance evidence.

requirements.text: Official OSERA releases must publish counterparts of the exact upstream baseline release's package files with the required checksums. Additional companion artifacts are optional; their absence must not fail acceptance when upstream does not publish them.

checks.title: Required release inventory and checksums are present

requirements.text: Published package metadata must identify the patched version consistently with REL-003.

checks.title: Package metadata uses the approved patched version

requirements.text: Each promoted release file must be bound to the patched release by its identity, SHA-256 digest, upload account and verified producer signature, and satisfy the applicable profile's content checks; unrecognized uploads remain in staging and are reported.

checks.title: Promoted files are bound to the release and unrecognized uploads are staged

requirements.text: The publication gate must retain an immutable acceptance record for each released binary or metadata-only package, identifying its exact artifacts, standards pack, standard versions, effective checks, results and evidence.

checks.title: Acceptance record preserves the exact release and evaluation rules
